name: Line / Area Chart (Trend)
when_to_pick: Show how a metric moves across an ordered axis (time, or any continuous progression) — an equity curve, cumulative P&L, account balance, drawdown vs recovery, slippage vs spread. Pass a single `values` series for one filled area, OR pass `datasets` (1-4 series) to overlay/compare lines on the same axis. This is THE trend-over-an-ordered-axis chart (it absorbed the old standalone line chart). Reach for chart_bar when the x-axis is discrete categories rather than an ordered progression; for the underwater equity view use drawdown_chart; for a single bounded score use gauge_meter.

tone.description: Fill/line colour for the SINGLE-series form (when you pass `values`). Ignored when you pass multi-series `datasets`.

values.description: Single-series form: one number per label, drawn as a filled area. Use this OR `datasets`, not both.

datasets.description: Multi-series form: 1-4 lines to overlay/compare on the same axis. Use this OR `values`.
